details: Bitcoin dropped below $67,000, Ether below $1,900, XRP under $1, and Solana below $75, triggering over $330 million in liquidations across the crypto market within a two-hour period on November 14, 2026. This sharp downturn indicates widespread market weakness and increased volatility, suggesting investors are reducing risk exposure.
title: Crypto Market Sees Major Sell-off, $330M Liquidated

details: JPMorgan Chase's latest quarterly 13F filing, reported on November 13, 2026, revealed approximately $981 million in crypto-linked holdings. This includes significant stakes in BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, Grayscale's and Bitwise's spot Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy), Coinbase, and Bitcoin miners, signaling a notable shift from a previously skeptical stance to a material portfolio allocation by the world's largest bank.
title: JPMorgan's Crypto Investments Approach $1 Billion Mark

details: On November 13, 2026, the FBI announced the seizure of over $1.2 billion in cryptocurrency related to a Binance hack, with the Department of Justice initiating a forfeiture action. This regulatory and security development, coupled with a new stablecoin settlement arrangement by Visa, has contributed to a defensive stance among digital asset traders.
title: FBI Seizes $1.2B from Binance Hack, DOJ Seeks Forfeiture

details: The Democratic Party securing control of both the Senate and House in the recent U.S. midterm elections has raised concerns about increased scrutiny and potentially tighter oversight for strategic industries, including artificial intelligence and cryptocurrencies. This political shift could complicate efforts to advance clear crypto regulatory frameworks like the Clarity Act, leading to heightened compliance risks and a "risk-off" sentiment in the crypto market.
title: US Midterm Results Raise Crypto Regulatory Scrutiny
